text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. When a developer finishes writing a piece of code, another team member carefully examines it before it is added to the main project. This process is excellent for catching bugs early, saving time and money that would otherwise be spent fixing problems later. More importantly, code reviews encourage knowledge sharing. Team members learn about different parts of the codebase and understand various coding styles. This helps to prevent a situation where only one person understands how a key system works. Ultimately, consistent code reviews raise the overall quality of the team, creating a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
